subject: giant weta
title: The Heaviest Insect Ever Weighed Outweighed a Golf Ball

scenes.text: Something with six legs outweighs a golf ball.
It's a giant weta from New Zealand, and the record one weighed 71 grams.
A golf ball weighs about 46. And that record weta was a pregnant female, carrying a belly full of eggs.
Most adults are smaller, between 9 and 35 grams, but still heavier than most insects.
It was weighed in 2011 on Little Barrier Island, off New Zealand.
So the heaviest insect ever weighed is a cricket relative.

description:
Something with six legs outweighs a golf ball.
The giant weta of New Zealand holds the record for the heaviest adult insect: a pregnant female weighed 71 grams in 2011. It is a distant relative of crickets.
Would you hold one?
first_comment: Would you hold a 71 gram insect, or would you run?
